input_observation.question: Why does this specific micro-geometry distinguish helpless horror ('Entsetzen') from startle ('Erschrecken') and why does it invalidate subsequent facial masking?

records.target_causal_explanation: Pure startle (AU1+AU2+AU5) elevates both medial and lateral brow segments along with the upper lid, opening the entire orbital frame. Defensive anger (AU4+AU7) lowers the medial brow and narrows the lid aperture. Helpless horror ('Entsetzen') triggers an involuntary subcortical collision between two opposing survival programs: sympathetic threat-acquisition (AU5 wide lid retraction + AU1 medial distress elevation) and protective orbital shielding (AU4 lateral brow depression). This contra-directional vector pair crushes the supraorbital fold against the retracted upper eyelid. Because the voluntary motor cortex cannot synthesize or suppress this opposing muscle synergy on command, human mirror neurons detect it within 150ms as unmasked limbic truth ('looking through the face into the soul').
